body:
## Summary

`CapFloor::setupArguments()` pre-adjusts `capRates`/`floorRates` to `(strike-spread)/gearing` before any pricing engine sees them — the analytic, Black and Bachelier cap/floor engines all rely on this pre-adjustment and place no restriction on the spread. `Gaussian1dCapFloorEngine` alone rejected every non-zero spread outright:

```cpp
for (Real spread : arguments_.spreads)
    QL_REQUIRE(spread == 0.0, "Non zero spreads (" << spread << ") are not allowed.");
```

even though its own calculation (`max(forward - capRate, 0) * gearing * nominal * accrual`, in both the deterministic and stochastic branches) uses the exact same pre-adjusted-strike pattern as the other engines and is already algebraically correct for any spread: substituting the pre-adjusted strike gives `max(gearing*forward + spread - K, 0) * nominal * accrual`, the correct capped-coupon payoff. The check was simply unnecessary and blocked valid inputs that every sibling engine already supports.

## Fix

Removed the restriction; left a comment explaining why it's safe to remove (the pre-adjustment already generalizes the payoff).

## Test

Added `testCapFloorNonZeroSpreadConsistency` to `test-suite/gsr.cpp`: prices a capped floating leg with a non-zero spread via `Gaussian1dCapFloorEngine` and checks it agrees with the mathematically equivalent zero-spread cap at a shifted strike. Confirmed it fails with the old check (throws `Non zero spreads (0.001) are not allowed.`) and passes with the fix. Full `GsrTests` and `MarkovFunctionalTests` suites (the latter being the only other test consumer of this engine) pass with no regressions.

🤖 Co-worked with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

review_comments.body: The fourth `Gsr` argument is mean reversion; with `50.0`, all forwards on this integration grid stay below the adjusted strike, so both cap NPVs are zero. The equality therefore passes even if the spread adjustment is ignored. Use a smaller mean reversion and require a positive reference NPV before comparing the prices.

Good catch, fixed in 020c8fdbd — lowered mean reversion to 0.01 and the strike to 0.01 (in-the-money against the 2% flat forward), and added a BOOST_REQUIRE that the reference NPV is non-trivially positive before comparing. Reference NPV is now ~0.061 rather than 0.

_🤖 Addressed by [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)_

The comment without the QL_REQUIRE is kind of puzzling :)
I'd just remove it.

title: Allow non-zero spreads in `Gaussian1dCapFloorEngine`
